# Environment classes

!!! abstract "Environment classes"

    * Environments execute the code generated by the LM/agent.
    * This project keeps two: direct host execution and Docker containers.

You can specify the environment class with the `--environment-class` flag or the
`environment.environment_class` key in the [agent config file](yaml_configuration.md).

* **`local`** ([`LocalEnvironment`](../reference/environments/local.md)). Executes commands directly on the host machine using `subprocess.run`. No isolation. Works in your current Python environment.

* **`docker`** ([`DockerEnvironment`](../reference/environments/docker.md)). Executes commands with `docker exec`. Use this for isolation and for SWE-bench.

`local` is the default for the [`trace`](../usage/trace.md) CLI. SWE-bench runs use `docker`.
